benign.title: A losing player loses to the whole table
benign.text: One player loses -174 bb per 100 hands overall (worse than 98% of pairs). Chips flowing to the partner may be part of losing to everyone.

benign.title: A hyper-aggressive player
benign.text: One player bets and raises 7.2x as often as they call (more than 93% of pairs). Folding to an aggressive player is normal; the question is whether the folds are specific to the partner.
